final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.order_id AS oid, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS cnt FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.oid, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.total, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.oid, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM s5
